title.narrative: EU4 Moldova Resilience ¿ secure state, resilient communities

description.narrative: The proposed action is prepared to respond to specific challengesand dynamically changing needs that the Republic of Moldova currently faces. Creation of atmosphere of cooperation and trust will be translated into strengthening immunity against internal and external threats. Thus, the action is planned as a quick response to the needs expressed by the partners that could enhance the capacities to prevent and handle destabilization, and at the same time creates opportunities to deliver tangible results to local communities connected to the EU integration, ensuring stronger links and communication/coordination mechanisms between local and central level. Ensuring flexibility of the intervention will be key to the success given the short intervention period and dynamic environment.
